title: Simultaneous stalk lifting of a finite family of standard free-sheaf matrices
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $y\in Y$ and let $V\subseteq Y$ be an open containing $y$. Let $I$ be a finite index type, and let $r,s:I\to\mathbf N$. For $q\in I$, write $F_q=\mathcal O_V^{\oplus r(q)}$ and $G_q=\mathcal O_V^{\oplus s(q)}$ for the standard free sheaves of modules (finite coproducts of the structure sheaf) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $T$ be pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback] along $V.\mathrm{fromSpecStalkOfMem}(y)$ from $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] to $V$. For every family $f_q:T(F_q)\to T(G_q)$, there exist an open $U\subseteq V$ containing $y$ and maps $g_q:R(F_q)\to R(G_q)$, where $R$ is restriction along $U\hookrightarrow V$ and $S$ is pullback along $U.\mathrm{fromSpecStalkOfMem}(y)$, with $S(g_q)=e(F_q).\mathrm{hom}\circ f_q\circ e(G_q).\mathrm{inv}$ in diagrammatic order. Here $e:R\circ S\simeq T$ is the specified natural comparison: restriction-as-pullback [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], followed by pullback composition and the equality of the two composite maps from the stalk scheme into $V$. The comparison is the construction [def-pc-stalk-restriction-within-iso].

proof.text: Use pullbackFreeIso to normalize each given map to a map between standard free sheaves on Spec O_{Y,y}. Read its entries with freeMatrix and ΓSpecIso. The dependent sum over q of the finite row and column positions is finite. Free matrices are constructed explicitly by Sigma.desc of the finite sums of scalarHom followed by the free inclusions. The identities ιFree_freeπ and sum_freeπ_ιFree prove realization and injectivity of freeMatrix; scalarHom is constructed from unitHomEquiv and the restrictions of a global section. These are the proved private helpers matrixHom, freeMatrix_matrixHom, and freeMatrix_injective in the delivered module.

Apply TopCat.Presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq to every coefficient with the prescribed upper open V. Let U be V intersected with the finite infimum of the representative opens. Restrict every representative to U and apply germ_res_apply. This proves the private helper finite_scalar_lift, including the empty family, where the infimum is top and U is V. The equality fromSpecStalkOfMem_toSpecΓ on global sections, together with ΓSpecIso_naturality and U.topIso, identifies the resulting germs with the appTop images of the coefficients on U (private helper stalk_appTop_eq_germ).

Realize the lifted coefficient matrices by the explicit matrixHom construction and conjugate by restrictFreeIso to obtain g_q. The theorem freeMatrix_pullback and the germ equalities identify the standard matrix of the stalk pullback of g_q with the normalized given matrix. Apply freeMatrix_injective to obtain equality of normalized maps.

Use the specified stalkRestrictionWithinIso e. Normalize e using the free isomorphisms on both its functors. Naturality on ιFree shows its normalized component on every free sheaf acts on each summand by the same endomorphism of the unit sheaf. The endomorphisms of the unit commute: evaluate on 1, use unit_hom_app_top, and use commutativity of global functions. By the free inclusions and coordinate projections, the common scalar therefore commutes with every finite matrix (private helpers scalar_naturality and free_conjugate_comparison). Compatibility of restrictFreeIso with inclusions follows immediately from naturality of restrictFunctorIsoPullback and pullback_map_ιFree_pullbackFreeIso_hom. Thus comparison_normalized identifies conjugation by e with the standard normalization of f. Combine it with the preceding normalized equality and cancel the free isomorphisms. No explicit coherence formula for pullback composition and no tilde/free-module comparison is required.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_free_matrices_of_stalk_local
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (r s : ι → ℕ)
    (f : ∀ q,
      (pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (r q)))) ⟶
      (pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (s q))))) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hyU : y ∈ U),
      let R := restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hUV)
      let S := pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)
      let e := stalkRestrictionWithinIso y V hyV U hUV hyU
      ∃ (g : ∀ q,
        R.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (r q)))) ⟶
        R.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (s q))))),
        ∀ q, S.map (g q) =
          (e.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin (r q))))).hom ≫ f q ≫
          (e.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin (s q))))).inv
